title: tinyml-gas-mixture-apollo3: TinyML gas-mixture recognition on the Ambiq Apollo3 Blue
description: Code and on-board results for the paper 'TinyML Gas-Mixture Recognition on an Ultra-Low-Power Microcontroller: Lessons from Simulation and Leakage-Free Real-Data Evaluation' (AIR'2026). Training and int8 quantization of a depthwise-separable 1D-CNN and feature baselines on the UCI dynamic gas-mixture recordings with a chronological split, TensorFlow Lite Micro firmware for the SparkFun Edge (Ambiq Apollo3 Blue), a hardware-in-the-loop protocol and the measured latency, Flash and arena of three firmware variants.
